column1: # Assay-identity worksheet for the `use` family of
# 294 oligo rows over 169 (paper, assay) pairs and 91 papers, 50 full texts fetched
# from Europe PMC. Verdicts: 13 CONFIRMED, 3 VARIANT, 153 UNCONFIRMABLE.

# the paper tested OUR assay. VARIANT means a near miss -- a related but different
# pair -- and is NEVER read as a confirmation. UNCONFIRMABLE means the text could
# not settle it (usually: the paper prints no oligo table and cites the assay only).
# NO ROW HERE IS A CASE. The eleven cases these rows led to are in
